name: Solo
ability_effect: Adds a rising bonus to combat initiative, attack, and damage as Street Cred grows.
flavor: Muscle, reflex, and the will to use both. Runs point.

name: Netrunner
ability_effect: Number of NET Actions per round; required to enter and fight in the NET architecture.
flavor: Jacks in and walks the floors while the meat waits.

name: Tech
ability_effect: Fabricate, repair, upgrade gear and cyberware; hotwire the getaway.
flavor: Keeps the crew's chrome running and the van moving.

name: Fixer
ability_effect: Sources jobs, contacts, and backup; better fences and intel as Street Cred grows.
flavor: The planner and the talker. The one who got you the job.
